subject.title: Feature: Add per-model generation timeout config

question: Should OpenClaw add a new public per-agent-model generation timeout surface, or keep operators on existing provider/run timeout surfaces plus narrower thinking and repetition fixes?
rationale: The request adds a public config/default surface and fallback semantics in a provider/runtime path that repository policy treats as compatibility-sensitive, so automation should not choose the product contract alone.

options.title: Define per-model generation timeout
options.body: Add a typed global and per-model generation budget with documented precedence, fallback classification, schema/docs coverage, and focused tests.

options.title: Use existing timeout surfaces
options.body: Decline a new config key and improve docs around agents.defaults.timeoutSeconds, models.providers.<id>.timeoutSeconds, first-event timeout, and idle watchdog behavior.

options.title: Split by failure mode
options.body: Route thinking stalls and repeated-output loops to their narrower canonical issues while leaving generation timeout out of scope for now.

recommendation.title: Define per-model generation timeout
recommendation.body: Add a typed global and per-model generation budget with documented precedence, fallback classification, schema/docs coverage, and focused tests.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the clearest prior review ownership and adjacent runtime/config history for the product-direction choice.
